_comment: One entry per project the routine runs in. Owner-edited; the agent never edits this folder.

rules: Every amount comes through <Fact> from data/** with source and verified_on (CLAUDE.md rule 3).
Primary sources only; a DDL is never presented as law (DDL banner).
Banned words: commercialista, ufficiale, garantito, ti conviene.
Title at most 60 characters (src/lib/tool-page.ts), description at most 155 (scripts/lib/content-lint.ts).
A new guide is registered in RELATED (src/lib/tool-page.ts) and GUIDES (src/lib/sections.ts), tied to a tool.
Legal pages and default scenarios: PR labelled needs-human.
No typed numbers: values come from {{bindings}}, checked by check:facts.
Never set reviewedOn: a guide is indexable only once the owner sets it.
A new page also needs a data/release-plan.json entry.
DE/FR/IT copy goes to the owner for review; say 'estimated', never 'official'.
Official sources only (ESTV, Fedlex, BSV); never scrape the ESTV calculator.
